scope: remote watchdog proof for unconfirmed container cleanup
boundaries: proves no process can keep producing results for that container
does not prove the interrupted job's output is valid
does not migrate a running process or restore lost in-memory state

Leftover sshpool-live-*/sshpool-manual-* containers on 182 still need removal once it answers again; this round does NOT claim 182 is clean.
